          UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"} => UniMsg[n].Data \in DATA

    /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" =>
          (ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE /\ ShWbMsg.Data \in DATA))

\* Only domains and control-field types are needed for protocol invariants.
FMSkeleton ==
    /\ Home \in NODE
    /\ DOMAIN Proc = NODE
    /\ \A n \in NODE :
          /\ DOMAIN Proc[n] = {"ProcCmd", "InvMarked", "CacheState", "CacheData"}
          /\ Proc[n].ProcCmd \in NODE_CMD
          /\ Proc[n].CacheState \in CACHE_STATE
          /\ Proc[n].InvMarked \in BOOLEAN
    /\ DOMAIN Dir = {"Pending", "Local", "Dirty", "HeadVld", "HeadPtr", "ShrVld", "ShrSet", "InvSet"}
    /\ Dir.Pending \in BOOLEAN /\ Dir.Local \in BOOLEAN /\ Dir.Dirty \in BOOLEAN
    /\ Dir.HeadVld \in BOOLEAN /\ Dir.ShrVld \in BOOLEAN
    /\ Dir.ShrSet \subseteq NODE /\ Dir.InvSet \subseteq NODE
    /\ DOMAIN UniMsg = NODE
    /\ \A n \in NODE : UniMsg[n].Cmd \in UNI_CMD
    /\ DOMAIN InvMsg = NODE
    /\ \A n \in NODE : InvMsg[n].Cmd \in INV_CMD
    /\ DOMAIN RpMsg = NODE
    /\ \A n \in NODE : RpMsg[n].Cmd \in RP_CMD
    /\ WbMsg.Cmd \in WB_CMD
    /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd \in SHWB_CMD
    /\ NakcMsg.Cmd \in NAKC_CMD
    /\ Collecting \in BOOLEAN

LEMMA FMTypeProjects == TypeOK => FMSkeleton
  BY FMP!SMTT("r3") DEF TypeOK, FMSkeleton

\* Local request bookkeeping, and the single active directory transaction.
FMIsRequest(n) == UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_GetX"}
FMHomeReply == UniMsg[Home].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"}

\* Request, forwarding, and invalidation phases agree with the directory.
FMProcControl ==
    \A n \in NODE :
      /\ (Proc[n].ProcCmd = "NODE_None" <=> UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_None")
      /\ (UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_Put"} => Proc[n].ProcCmd = "NODE_Get")
      /\ (UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_GetX", "UNI_PutX"} => Proc[n].ProcCmd = "NODE_GetX")
      /\ (Proc[n].ProcCmd # "NODE_None" => Proc[n].CacheState # "CACHE_E")
      /\ (n # Home /\ Proc[n].ProcCmd # "NODE_None" => Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_I")
      /\ (Proc[n].InvMarked => Proc[n].ProcCmd = "NODE_Get")
      /\ (FMIsRequest(n) => UniMsg[n].Proc \in NODE \ {n})
      /\ ((n # Home /\ ((UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Get" /\ UniMsg[n].Proc # Home)
                             \/ UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Put"))
             => RpMsg[n].Cmd # "RP_Replace")

FMDirectoryControl ==
    /\ (Proc[Home].ProcCmd # "NODE_None" => ~Dir.Local)
    /\ ~Proc[Home].InvMarked
    /\ (Dir.Local /\ Dir.Dirty => Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_E")
    /\ (~Dir.Local /\ Dir.Dirty => Dir.HeadVld)
    /\ (Dir.HeadVld => Dir.HeadPtr \in NODE \ {Home})
    /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE \ {Home})

FMForwardControl ==
    /\ FwdCmd \in {"UNI_None", "UNI_Get", "UNI_GetX"}
    /\ (FwdCmd # "UNI_None" =>
          /\ PendReqSrc \in NODE
          /\ UniMsg[PendReqSrc].Cmd = FwdCmd
          /\ UniMsg[PendReqSrc].Proc # Home)
    /\ \A n \in NODE :
          (FMIsRequest(n) /\ UniMsg[n].Proc # Home) =>
            /\ PendReqSrc = n
            /\ FwdCmd = UniMsg[n].Cmd

FMPhaseControl ==
    /\ (Dir.Pending /\ ~Collecting => ~Dir.Local)
    /\ (Dir.Pending <=>
          (Collecting \/ FwdCmd # "UNI_None" \/ NakcMsg.Cmd # "NAKC_None"
           \/ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" \/ FMHomeReply))
    /\ (Collecting =>
          /\ FwdCmd = "UNI_None" /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None"
          /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None" /\ ~FMHomeReply)
    /\ (FwdCmd # "UNI_None" =>
          /\ ~Collecting /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None"
          /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None" /\ ~FMHomeReply /\ ~Dir.Local)
    /\ (NakcMsg.Cmd # "NAKC_None" =>
          /\ ~Collecting /\ FwdCmd = "UNI_None"
          /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None" /\ ~FMHomeReply)
    /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" =>
          /\ ~Collecting /\ FwdCmd = "UNI_None"
          /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ~FMHomeReply)

FMInvalidationControl ==
    /\ InvMsg[Home].Cmd = "INV_None"
    /\ \A n \in NODE : InvMsg[n].Cmd # "INV_None" => Collecting
    /\ (Collecting =>
          /\ ~Dir.ShrVld
          /\ Dir.InvSet = {n \in NODE : InvMsg[n].Cmd # "INV_None"})

FMControl == FMProcControl /\ FMDirectoryControl /\ FMForwardControl
             /\ FMPhaseControl /\ FMInvalidationControl

\* The dirty value has a unique owner, possibly in transit.
\* Coherence: unique exclusive ownership, coverage of shared copies,
\* and the corresponding current/previous data values.
FMCacheOwner(n) == Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_E"
FMGrantOwner(n) == UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_PutX"
FMExclusive == (\E n \in NODE : FMCacheOwner(n) \/ FMGrantOwner(n)) \/ WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb"
FMLiveShared(n) == Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_S"
                  \/ (UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[n].InvMarked)

FMToken ==
    /\ \A p \in NODE : FMCacheOwner(p) =>
          /\ Dir.Dirty
          /\ WbMsg.Cmd # "WB_Wb"
          /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_ShWb"
          /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put"
          /\ \A q \in NODE :
                /\ (FMCacheOwner(q) => q = p)
                /\ ~FMGrantOwner(q)
    /\ \A p \in NODE : FMGrantOwner(p) =>
          /\ Dir.Dirty
          /\ WbMsg.Cmd # "WB_Wb"
          /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_ShWb"
          /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put"
          /\ \A q \in NODE : FMGrantOwner(q) => q = p
    /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" =>
          /\ Dir.Dirty /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_ShWb" /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put")
    /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" =>
          /\ Dir.Dirty /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put")
    /\ (UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put" => Dir.Dirty)
    /\ (Dir.Dirty => FMExclusive \/ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" \/ UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put")

FMOwnerLocation(n) ==
    IF Dir.Local THEN n = Home
    ELSE IF ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_FAck" THEN n = ShWbMsg.Proc
    ELSE IF UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_PutX" THEN n = Home
    ELSE n = Dir.HeadPtr

FMOwnerControl ==
    /\ \A n \in NODE : (FMCacheOwner(n) \/ FMGrantOwner(n)) => FMOwnerLocation(n)
    /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" =>
          /\ WbMsg.Proc \in NODE \ {Home}
          /\ FMOwnerLocation(WbMsg.Proc))

FMSharerShape ==
    /\ (~Dir.Local => Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_I")
    /\ (Dir.ShrVld => Dir.HeadVld)
    /\ (~Dir.ShrVld => Dir.ShrSet = {})
    /\ Dir.ShrSet \subseteq NODE \ {Home}
    /\ (Dir.Dirty => ~Dir.ShrVld)

FMCollectingOwner ==
    Collecting =>
      /\ Dir.InvSet # {}
      /\ PendReqSrc \in NODE
      /\ PendReqSrc \notin Dir.InvSet
      /\ \A n \in NODE :
            /\ (FMCacheOwner(n) => n = PendReqSrc)
            /\ (FMGrantOwner(n) => n = PendReqSrc /\ UniMsg[n].Proc = Home)

FMSharedCoverage ==
    \A n \in NODE : FMLiveShared(n) =>
      IF Collecting
      THEN n # Home /\ InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_Inv"
      ELSE /\ ~FMExclusive
           /\ (n # Home =>
                 /\ Dir.HeadVld
                 /\ n = Dir.HeadPtr
                    \/ (Dir.ShrVld /\ n \in Dir.ShrSet)
                    \/ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" /\ n = ShWbMsg.Proc))

FMReplacementCoverage ==
    \A n \in NODE :
      (n # Home /\ ~Collecting /\ RpMsg[n].Cmd = "RP_Replace" /\ FMLiveShared(n)) =>
        Dir.HeadVld /\ n = Dir.HeadPtr

FMDataConsistency ==
    /\ CacheDataProp
    /\ MemDataProp
    /\ \A n \in NODE :
          /\ (FMGrantOwner(n) => UniMsg[n].Data = CurrData)
          /\ (UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[n].InvMarked =>
                UniMsg[n].Data = IF Collecting THEN PrevData ELSE CurrData)
    /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" => WbMsg.Data = CurrData)
    /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" => ShWbMsg.Data = CurrData)
    /\ (UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put" => UniMsg[Home].Data = CurrData)

FMCoherence == FMToken /\ FMOwnerControl /\ FMSharerShape /\ FMCollectingOwner
               /\ FMSharedCoverage /\ FMReplacementCoverage /\ FMDataConsistency

\* Ranks for the unicast and invalidation channels.
\* The unicast ranks are: request at Home, forwarded request, reply, done.
\* Weak fairness drains each rank; replacement messages unblock Home requests.
FMUniDone(n) == UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_None"
FMUniReply(n) == UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Nak", "UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"}
FMUniForward(n) == FMIsRequest(n) /\ UniMsg[n].Proc # Home
FMUniAtHome(n) == FMIsRequest(n) /\ UniMsg[n].Proc = Home
FMUniLow(n) == FMUniReply(n) \/ FMUniDone(n)
FMUniMiddle(n) == FMUniForward(n) \/ FMUniLow(n)
FMInvDone(n) == InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_None"
FMInvAcked(n) == InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_InvAck"
FMInvSent(n) == InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_Inv"
FMRpDone(n) == RpMsg[n].Cmd = "RP_None"

    /\ \A n \in NODE :
          /\ (FMUniReply(n) => FMUniLow(n)')
          /\ (FMUniForward(n) => FMUniMiddle(n)')
          /\ (~FMUniDone(n) /\ FMRpDone(n) => FMRpDone(n)')
          /\ (FMInvAcked(n) => (FMInvAcked(n) \/ FMInvDone(n))')
          /\ (Dir.Pending /\ FMInvDone(n) => FMInvDone(n)')
          /\ (Dir.Pending /\ ~FMUniForward(n) => ~FMUniForward(n)')
    /\ (Dir.Pending /\ ~Collecting => ~Collecting')
    /\ (Dir.Pending /\ FwdCmd = "UNI_None" => (FwdCmd = "UNI_None")')
    /\ (Dir.Pending /\ FwdCmd = "UNI_None" /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None"

    /\ (Dir.Pending /\ FwdCmd = "UNI_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
